name: Mobile Validator for Travel Documents

description: ICAO 9303 eDocument reader using NFC, MRZ/OCR, and facial recognition for ePassports, national eIDs, and resident permits.

hero.headline: Inspect and Verify ePassports, National eIDs, and More
hero.sub: An ICAO 9303 eDocument reader using NFC, photo/MRZ/OCR scan, and facial recognition. Embeddable in any Android or iOS app with a customisable UI and CSCA validation.
bullets: ICAO 9303 ePassports, eIDs, visas, and resident permits
NFC, MRZ/OCR, barcode, and 1:1 facial recognition
On-device processing: data never leaves the device
KYC-ready data extraction into System of Records

showcase.statCopy: ICAO-standard eDocument reading with offline, privacy-first validation

features.body: Automate form completion and KYC by extracting photo, name, validity, date of birth, document number, nationality, and gender while validating into a back-end platform.
Fully programmable UI/UX for Android 6+ and iOS 13+ (NFC iPhones), with live video or saved images, portrait and landscape modes, and CSCA validation service.
Deliver on-premises, as SaaS, as managed service, or as a stand-alone SDK/Core API for identity providers, issuing authorities, and trusted providers.

discover.copy: NFC card authentication that derives credentials from security documents into mobile virtual IDs.
Carry official physical and digital credentials on your phone with EUDI-ready wallet support.
Authenticate a fleet of readers for secure online and offline data transfer from wallets and mIDs.

statement: Built for the growth in international travel and the need to trust travel documents, Scytáles Mobile Validator for Travel Documents brings ICAO 9303 validation to the mobile device: fast, reliable, and secure with offline processing.
